plugin.note: Complete Lost City and reach combat level 40, then travel to Zanaris (via a fairy ring or the Lost City route). The Otherworldly beings roam south of the bank by the flower pond. They have a 35% weakness to air spells, so Magic (air spells) is the most effective style; melee also works given their modest defences. Safespot them across the flower pond or corner-trap them on the pond corners to avoid taking damage, as they can be hard to pin down when they wander.

mechanics: Otherworldly beings are assigned only by Vannaka (40-90), weighting 8, with no extended amount.
Assignment requires combat level 40 and completion of Lost City; no Slayer level requirement (slayerLevel set to 0).

Otherworldly beings have 66 Hitpoints, max hit 7 (Crush), 4-tick attack speed, and Defence level 46; a 25 June 2025 update gave them a 35% air weakness and a -2 flat armour value.
Considered spectral: the Ectoplasmator grants Prayer XP on kill. Not undead.

methods.label: Zanaris (south of the bank, flower pond)
steps: Six Otherworldly beings roam south of the Zanaris bank by the flower pond; Lost City is required for access.
Safespot by standing next to the pond and attacking across it, or corner-trap on the pond corners; five of the six have a wander radius that allows safespotting, though they move around a lot.
They are weak to air spells (35%), making Magic a strong option; also a source of runes, herbs, and Magic XP.
